answer: One concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. Today's words line up with the mechanism: ripple maps onto the compute burned to admit each new identity, orchard mirrors the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, and quill stands for the slashing that punishes duplicate work. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
